summary: Quick focused test of free step navigation + Review submit guard + admin WhatsApp status alerts. Backend 4/4 pytest pass (client guard 400 with step list, admin bypass, full-completion submit -> In Review, admin status Waiting on Documents ok; WhatsApp attempted, only Twilio 63007 'NOT sent' logged, no tracebacks). UI: all desktop+mobile step buttons enabled, Next always enabled, ?step=review deep link works, review-missing-ein/documents navigate with ?step=key, submit disabled when incomplete; on complete case (fresh TEST client) submit enabled, after disclosures submission succeeds, badge shown, status In Review. Found and fixed mobile horizontal overflow; found 2 minor frontend bugs (below).

minor.issue: Backend log: Brevo send failed 'account is blocked due to malicious behavior' (permission_denied). Resend rejects example.com recipients (expected for test). Pre-existing, unrelated to this feature, but means Brevo fallback is dead.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a review-missing-{key} chip a 2nd time does nothing when the URL is already ?step={key} (e.g. click EIN chip -> go back to Review via sidebar (URL stays ?step=ein) -> click EIN chip again -> stays on Review). Root cause: IntakeWizard deep-link effect only reacts to searchParams changes; sidebar gotoStep doesn't update URL. Fix: make gotoStep call setSearchParams({step: key}) (keeps URL in sync & refresh-safe) or pass an onGoto callback to ReviewStep instead of navigate().

Banner always says 'All required intake sections are complete.' even when review-missing-steps lists incomplete steps (now reachable thanks to free navigation). Should be conditional on missing.length === 0.

FIXED by testing agent: at 390px the page had horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 1161) because the min-w-max step strip expanded the grid track. Added min-w-0 to <aside data-testid='intake-step-nav'>; verified scrollWidth 390.

issues: Floating chat bubble overlaps the bottom-right Next / Back to Portal button (wizard-next-btn / wizard-done-btn) partially covering its label.

action_items: Sync step with URL in IntakeWizard.gotoStep (setSearchParams) so review-missing chips always navigate
Make review-complete-banner text conditional on missingSteps() being empty
Move/offset the floating chat bubble so it does not cover wizard-next-btn
(Optional) Brevo account blocked - email fallback broken
critical_code_review_comments: IntakeWizard: `locked` is now constant false; Lock icon/locked classes are dead code - remove.
Frontend/backend completeness rules duplicated (intakeProgress.js vs _intake_missing_steps) - fine but keep in sync; backend Documents check covers review path correctly.
pwtest case 562399a8 is in status 'In Review' while still missing EIN + Documents (from earlier admin testing) - not a bug of this feature.
